Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Allianz Re IT and Enterprise Architecture within H4 Allianz SE Solo Operations, IT and organization Allianz Re's Retained IT function of Allianz Reinsurance. We act as the key interface between business stakeholders, service providers, and Group functions, ensuring that IT services are secure, compliant, cost-effective, and aligned with Allianz standards and regulatory requirements.
As an IT Service Demand Manager, you will shape and govern the technology demand for Allianz Re's business applications and IT services. You will act as the central point of coordination between business owners, Allianz Technology, and internal governance functions, ensuring business requirements are translated into effective technology solutions and delivered according to agreed service levels. You will oversee service performance, manage provider relationships, support budgeting and financial planning, and drive continuous improvement across your service portfolio.
This role is ideal for professionals looking to move beyond pure delivery roles and work at the intersection of business demand management, technology governance, enterprise architecture, AI enablement, and IT risk oversight. You will gain exposure to Allianz Re's global business, emerging technologies, and senior stakeholders.

How can you make an impact?

You will:

- Review the Service Agreements and the fulfillment for the Service Agreements based on monitoring information requested from the Service Provider
- Conduct reviews on business applications with respect to IT policies, internal /Allianz Group standards and where applicable enterprise architecture governance models. Follow up and apply in cases where necessary, report results to IT management

- Shape and manage business demand related to AI use cases, automation initiatives, and process improvements

- Ensure quality of service provider's deliverables
- Contribute to IT cost planning and controlling with in depth knowledge about own services and quantity structures
- Foster reliable relationships with relevant stakeholders and interfaces

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field

Professional Experience

- 3-5+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas: IT Solution Architecture, IT Product Ownership, Technology Consulting, Software Engineering, Business Analysis

Technical Skills

- Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles, application lifecycle management, and technology governance
- Interest in and exposure to AI technologies, like Machine Learning (ML), Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, AI-enabled enterprise solutions
- Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS
- Understanding of scalable, resilient, and secure enterprise architectures integrating AI into existing systems
- Understanding of IT governance, information security, and risk management principles
- Knowledge of regulatory frameworks such as DORA and EU AI Act or willingness to rapidly acquire expertise in these areas
- Ability to translate regulatory and compliance requirements into practical application-level controls and governance processes

Personal Skills

- Ability to challenge constructively and influence stakeholders at different organizational levels
- Business-oriented mindset with strong customer focus
- Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in international and cross-functional environments
- Ability to operate successfully in complex, fast-paced, and evolving environments

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience within insurance, reinsurance, financial services
- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus
Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solution

Relevant certifications such as:

- Microsoft Azure

- TOGAF
- ITIL

Languages

- Fluent English (written and spoken) is required

- Multinational and inclusive community
- Great career development and learning opportunities

- Employee stock purchase program with a discount
